title: The Integrations admin pages depend on the Integrations sub-toggle, not on Finance
custom_preconds:
1. Two custom roles are set up, each with a user:
  2. Role A: Settings > App Settings ON and Settings > Integrations ON.
  3. Role B: Settings > Finance ON and Settings > Integrations OFF.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the Role A user and open the Settings area.
Look for the Integrations pages (for example IBS).
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Integrations pages, including IBS, are shown.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the Role B user (Finance on, Integrations off) and open the Settings area.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Settings area opens and Payment Methods is shown.
The Integrations pages, including IBS, are not shown — having Finance on does not unlock Integrations.

evidence: UI: a Finance-only role (settingsFinance, no settingsIntegrations = SetFin) shows the FINANCE group (Payment Methods, Taxes) but NO INTEGRATIONS group (no IBS/Open API/QuickBooks) — Integrations admin pages depend on the Integrations sub-toggle, not on Finance. screenshot settings-SetFin.
